subject: AtlasAI: competitive economics + migration & licensing breakdown
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@atlasai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@atlasai.com>, procurement@atlasai.com
Date: 2027-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: pricing comparison + migration plan (AtlasAI RFP attached)

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached is the updated RFP (AtlasAI_RFP_v2.pdf). To move procurement and the exec committee along we need a concise, line-item comparison between our current vendor (CloudForge) and Redwood: total cost of ownership over 18 months, migration credits, implementation timelines, and any feature deltas that would materially affect cost (dedicated capacity, KV caching, egress).

High-level context:
- Current usage profile: ~150M generated tokens / month, 12 concurrency workers, heavy daytime burst traffic.
- CloudForge has offered a 24‑month prepay with a 30% discount and an onboarding credit of $125k.
- Procurement is sensitive to both near-term savings and predictable unit economics; any credits should be explicit and tied to milestones.

Can you send a short comparison table and a proposed migration schedule/credit structure by EOD tomorrow? Also include any contract packaging options (monthly vs annual commit, prepay buckets, dedicated tiers) and what we'd need from AtlasAI to hit the onboarding milestones.

Attachments: AtlasAI_RFP_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Platform Partnerships
AtlasAI

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@atlasai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pricing comparison + migration plan (AtlasAI RFP attached)

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the RFP — we reviewed it this morning. Quick confirmation that we can deliver the comparison + migration plan. Looping in Jordan (pricing lead) and Marissa (dedicated deployment/ops) — they'll add the detailed numbers and a migration timeline.

What we'll provide by EOD tomorrow:
- 18‑month TCO comparison (list vs negotiated, credits amortized)
- Two packaging options: 18‑month commit vs 24‑month prepay (with associated discounts)
- Migration credit proposal tied to go‑live milestones (POC, data ingest complete, traffic switch)
- Implementation timeline with 2, 4, and 8‑week cutoff milestones and required AtlasAI deliverables

Initial note: we typically price hosted inference per generated token and offer a dedicated tier for predictable throughput. For a baseline scenario (150M tokens/month) we can usually surface a mid‑term effective price that competes with prepay offers while preserving flexibility.

Jordan / Marissa — please see the RFP and recommend a compact proposal set we can share with procurement.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@atlasai.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-18T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pricing comparison + migration plan (AtlasAI RFP attached)

Samantha —

Thanks — attached is a compact economics snapshot and the switch timeline (RW_Atlas_switch_timeline.xlsx). Below is the executive summary and a worked example so procurement can see the math.

Executive summary (competing against CloudForge 24m prepay w/ 30% off):
- Usage baseline: 150,000,000 generated tokens / month (we used your RFP monthly average).
- CloudForge prepay offer: list $0.008/token -> after 30% = $0.0056/token effective
- Redwood hosted list: $0.009/token (public list) — Typical annual commit discount yields 18–22% depending on term.

Redwood 18‑month proposal (proposal A):
- Committed monthly: 150M tokens (rollup)
- Effective unit: $0.0065/token (base 18% effective discount off list)
- Annualized spend (18mo): 150M * 0.0065 * 18 = $17,550,000
- Migration/onboarding credit: $150,000 one‑time applied as a credit to first invoice (milestoneed: 50% on POC completion, 50% on traffic switch)
- Onboarding professional services: $30,000 (included in first invoice) for integration and load tests
- Overage rate (pay‑as‑you‑go beyond committed baseline): $0.0072/token (we cap monthly overage exposure at 20% of committed amount)

Redwood 24‑month prepay option (proposal B):
- Prepay bucket: 3,600M tokens total (24 * 150M)
- Effective unit: $0.0059/token (additional 10% vs 18mo for prepaid liquidity)
- Prepay required at signature; migration credit: $125,000 (applied after traffic switch)

Operational differentiators to highlight to procurement / execs:
- Dedicated tier availability: If AtlasAI wants reserved GPU pools, we can price a Dedicated instance with stricter SLAs; that tends to lower per-token cost for bursty patterns because of fixed-cost amortization.
- KV prefix caching and autoscaling policies reduce steady‑state cost for repeat prompts (we can quantify with a short workload scan).
- Egress: We do not charge for model output egress inside US regions for hosted API customers; if AtlasAI needs private deployment or specific VPC egress patterns, we’ll coordinate with infrastructure on egress allowances.

Example math (18‑month):
- Monthly: 150M tokens * $0.0065 = $975,000
- 18 months -> $17,550,000
- Less migration credit $150,000 -> net $17,400,000
- Effective unit after credit (net / total tokens) = $17,400,000 / (150M * 18) ≈ $0.00644/token

Requested next steps from AtlasAI for us to finalize a redline:
1) Confirm preferred term (18mo vs 24mo prepaid)
2) Approve milestone definitions for migration credit (we propose: POC signoff, data ingest complete, traffic cutover)
3) Indicate any procurement constraints re: vendor onboarding paperwork / security attestations (SOC2 evidence we can provide)

Attachments: RW_Atlas_switch_timeline.xlsx (milestones), RW_Atlas_pricing_snapshot.pdf (detailed line items)

Jordan Blake
Pricing Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@atlasai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@atlasai.com>, procurement@atlasai.com
Date: 2027-09-19T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pricing comparison + migration plan (AtlasAI RFP attached)

Rachel / Jordan —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the worked example. A few procurement asks before we send this to legal:

1) Can Redwood reduce the overage rate and raise the monthly overage cap to 30%? CloudForge gave us a 30% buffer which helps avoid immediate true‑up exposures during ramp.
2) Can the migration credit be bumped to $200k if AtlasAI signs an 18‑month commit and a 12‑month priority onboarding SLA? We need the extra to offset internal migration costs.
3) We need a 90‑day implementation SLA documented in the term sheet (we can negotiate carveouts for data delays).

Also — procurement prefers DocuSign routing and a single PO reference field on the signature page. If you can produce a term sheet with these items, we’ll share with legal and aim to have an answer within 48 hours.

Regards,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Platform Partnerships
AtlasAI

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@atlasai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-19T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pricing comparison + migration plan (AtlasAI RFP attached)

Samantha —

We can accommodate procurement's asks with the following updated proposal. I’ve attached the term sheet (RW_Atlas_term_sheet_v1.pdf) and a DocuSign envelope ready for your PO routing (link below). Changes vs earlier draft:

Updated commercial bullets (final):
- Term: 18 months
- Committed monthly: 150M tokens
- Effective unit: $0.00645/token (net of credits when amortized)
- Migration credit: $130,000 one‑time credit (50% on POC signoff, 50% on traffic cutover). We understand you asked for $200k; to bridge the ask while keeping economics balanced we increased onboarding services included to $45k (training, extra load tests) and raised the overage cap.
- Overage: $0.0069/token; monthly overage cap moved to 30% of committed tokens (as requested)
- Implementation SLA: 90 calendar days to production post kickoff, with exceptions for delayed AtlasAI deliverables documented in the term sheet
- DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC12345

Net financial example (18 months):
- Gross spend before credits: $17,550,000
- Less migration credit: $130,000 -> net $17,420,000
- Included PS (non‑recurring) value: $45,000

Next steps:
1) Are you comfortable with the $130k credit + $45k included services trade? If so I’ll initiate the DocuSign routing with a PO field and a 72‑hour review window for legal.
2) If AtlasAI needs the full $200k credit we can escalate to a commercial review — it would likely require a 24‑month prepaid commit at $0.0058/token and a case review by finance.

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk legal through the term sheet.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
